aboutHeading: Top End Panels - Sunshine's Trusted Repair Shop
aboutText: Located at 45 Wright St in Sunshine, Top End Panels is a dedicated car repair shop with years of experience in smash repairs, panel beating, and spray painting. We handle all insurance claims smoothly and offer courtesy cars for convenience. Our skilled team delivers flawless workmanship, restoring vehicles to their best condition with precision and care for the local community.
servicesText: At Top End Panels in Sunshine, we provide a full range of car repair services, from minor dent fixes to major smash repairs. Our experts specialise in insurance claims and high-quality spray painting, ensuring your vehicle looks as good as new with efficient and reliable work.

services.title: Smash Repairs
services.desc: Expert repair of accident damage, restoring your vehicle's structure and appearance with meticulous attention to detail.

services.title: Panel Beating
services.desc: Precision reshaping and replacement of body panels to factory standards for a seamless finish.

services.title: Spray Painting
services.desc: Professional respraying with advanced colour matching for a flawless and durable result.

services.title: Insurance Repairs
services.desc: Hassle-free claims management and direct billing with insurers to simplify the repair process.

services.title: Dent Repairs
services.desc: Efficient removal of dents and minor damage without the need for repainting, saving time and cost.

services.title: Courtesy Car Service
services.desc: Free loan vehicle available while your car is being repaired, keeping you on the move in Sunshine.
